name: cr601_5_a_free_cast_stands_as_its_permission_is_sacrificed
why: CR 601.5: what lets a spell be cast may be lost while its costs are paid. Omniscience, sacrificed to Beseech the Mirror's bargain, still let it be cast without paying its mana cost.
expect_order: Player A casts Beseech the Mirror without paying its mana cost
Player A casts Beseech the Mirror
